attackers_goals: Attackers may use various methods to execute code in the context of a signed process to avoid detection.
description: A signed process loaded a DLL that, on a global level, it usually doesn't load.
detector_tags: Global Anomaly Analytics, DLL Hijacking Analytics
investigative_actions: Check if the actor process loaded a suspicious DLL before the alert. Check if the actor process was injected before the alert. Check if the process execution and connections are legitimate.
